name: Tactical Spellcasting
body:
You can move before and after spellcasting.

Prerequisites: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, Spellcraft 1 rank.

Benefit: When casting a spell with a casting time of 1 standard action, you may move both before and after your spell is cast if the total distance moved is not greater than your current speed.
